youtube.title: Pulses to the music, still loops: funkbox's new audio-loop mode, from a GLSL shader
youtube.description:
Pulses to the music. Still loops.
New in funkbox: a shader loop that reacts to a song, and the seam is still checked by machine. Rendered in under 40 s on 4 CPU cores, no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
